Don't miss the ‘So Be It’ Clip for Verity, an upcoming psychological thriller distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. After Verity's car accident, Anna gets an offer of a lifetime in Verity, in theaters on October 2.

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.

Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
End of Abyss Review
End of Abyss reviewed by Jesse Vitelli on PC, also available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

"End of Abyss has so much going for it as a metroidvania with touches of survival horror and twin-stick shooting. However, all of these pieces don't coalesce into something greater. Instead they make for an uneven experience that isn't quite up to the bar set by other juggernauts in the genre. While the atmosphere Section 9 Interactive created matches even the best moments of other horror games, it isn't enough to make up for the way it undermines its best ideas. End of Abyss has moments that shine through even the darkest depths of its abandoned facility, but not enough to flood the surface."

text:
Guillermo del Toro on Making a Bioshock Movie & Why He’ll Will Never Make a Video Game
IGN’s Brian Altano sat down with Academy Award-winning director Guillermo del Toro for a career-spanning interview. 

In this Guillermo del Toro interview breakout, Guillermo talks about his collaboration with Hideo Kojima on Unsane and their inability to get it off the ground. Brian and del Toro also chat about the different dynamics at play between video games and movies and the “contentious” calls he had about potentially adapting a couple of video games into movies like Bioshock.
Finally, at 3:02, Guillermo del Toro talks about his favorite video games of all time.

text:
GTA 6 Devs Visited Real Strip Clubs for Research - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
The developers at Rockstar Games were all hard at work researching for Grand Theft Auto 6, and that includes the arduous and time-consuming task of visiting strip clubs. For no other reason to be as accurate as possible for the game. No other reason at all. In other news, Switch 2 owners can apparently claim a copy of The Witcher 3 Remastered for free, provided you know someone with a physical copy of the Switch 1 version. There's a good chance CD Projekt RED will find a way to patch this out, so claim it while you can. And finally, Capcom has a plan for when their remakes catch up to the modern games. With a Code Veronica remake already announced—and assuming they don't do an RE Zero and another RE1 remake—they only have Resident Evils 5 and 6 left.
